correctness.rationale: PASS: For each fixed odd n>=5 the unique smooth diameter contacts localize on 2n ordered mutually centered arc pairs; all other corner intersections have O(epsilon^2) unnormalized mass. The exact arclength chart x(s)=(1-cos s,sin s), y(t)=(cos t,sin t) gives distance squared 1-4sin(s/2)[sin(s/2+t)-sin(s/2)], so the local deficit behaves like st and is t sin s+O_s(t^2) along the t=0 axis. With delta=epsilon^(1/3), inner-square st area plus two outer strips yields epsilon[log(1/epsilon)+1+2log(2tan(pi/(2n)))]+o(epsilon), and summing ordered sectors and dividing by perimeter squared pi^2 produces the displayed coefficient. On compact 0<u,w<1 the logarithmic-coordinate Jacobian is epsilon log(1/epsilon)(1+o(1)), and Scheffe gives total-variation marked convergence. Fixed n and width-1 arclength model essential; finite quadrature cannot establish limit.
